{{Quote|It was a small reconnaissance force, but it fought with a savage ferocity before it was finally repulsed.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo, to Kinman Doriana|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
At some point by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], establishes that the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] have already [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|fought]] the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the events of the novel take place.</ref> a small '''reconnaissance force''' of the [[Praetorite Vong]] participated in the [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|battle]] against a [[Ar'alani's force|force]] of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]], in which the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] were defeated.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
